prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original monochrome pen-and-ink literary book illustration on pure white paper, fine black contours and restrained light crosshatching, no colour, sepia or grey wash. A dignified everyday imagined meal-preparation scene: one adult in plain practical clothing seated beside a small simple cooking hearth, calmly tending a pot with faint steam; a modest bundle of fuel sticks nearby and a second bowl waiting for the meal. Show believable hands, tools and pot support, ordinary composed posture, no misery caricature, no luxurious feast, no onlookers judging the person, no claim about income or poverty. The scene conveys work and fuel needed for hot food rather than wealth. Quiet spacious composition with generous white margins, selective detail, readable at small book size, no lettering, border, symbols, watermark or text. Black ink only on white background.
caption: An imagined meal being prepared, with fuel and work behind the warmth.
alt: A seated adult stirs a steaming pot over a small hearth, with fuel sticks and an empty bowl nearby.
